Design.evidence_source: This reduction of 29 percentage points or 48% is statistically signicant at the 5% level (Fisher's exact test (FET), p=0.027).14 Hence, although about two-thirds of subjects choose to punish altruistically if the information about the egoistic dictator behavior is readily made available, only one-third choose to do so if the information has to be revealed.
